# Index — Alphabetical {#sec-index-alpha}

Every defined or coined term in the lexicon, in one place. The built-in
site search (top of every page) complements this index: search finds a word
anywhere in the prose, while this list is the curated set of terms the
document actually defines, each pointing to where it is introduced.

Zone codes **A1–A5** are grouped under **A**; sharing positions **S1–S4**
under **S**.

---

## A

**A1 — Farmstead** — <100 kW, behind-the-meter, single owner-operator, existing farm labour — [1.2 The Zones](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)

**A2 — Field** — 100 kW–1 MW, behind-meter to distribution, landowner with possibly one lease counterparty — [1.2 The Zones](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)

**A3 — Parcel** — 1–10 MW, distribution / community solar, multi-party, purpose-built ground management — [1.2 The Zones](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)

**A4 — Landscape** — 10–50 MW, developer-led institutional capital, contract-enterprise management — [1.2 The Zones](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)

**A5 — Regional** — 50 MW+, transmission, utility/IPP, contract enterprise at ranch scale — [1.2 The Zones](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)

**Agricultural continuity** — design pressure: keep working land working — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

**Agrisolar** — agroenergy specific to photovoltaics; this lexicon's primary term of art, neutral across the sharing–sparing axis — [Agrisolar](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-agrisolar)

**Agrivoltaics** — crop or livestock production within the array footprint (S1–S2); *cf.* agrophotovoltaics, photovoltaic agriculture — [Agrivoltaics](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-agrivoltaics)

**Agroenergy** — energy infrastructure designed to interact intentionally with agricultural or ecological land function; umbrella term — [Agroenergy](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-agroenergy)

**Archetype** — a way the design pressures have been resolved at a particular scale zone and sharing position; the structure register — [5. Archetypes](5-archetypes.qmd)

## C

**Capital discipline** — design pressure: minimize installed cost per watt — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

**Carrying capacity** — season-long forage the land sustains over time; a grazing design variable — [1.3 Why the transect earns its place](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-grazing)

**Co-location** — panels and a land use share a parcel without functional interdependence; *cf.* integration — [Co-location vs. Integration](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-colocation-integration)

**Community Benefit** — instruments returning value to the host community (CBA/HCA, PILOT, good-neighbor payments, community-solar subscription, co-ownership, decommissioning bond); distinct from acceptance — [Community Benefit](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-community-benefit)

**Contract grazing** — grazing delivered as a contracted vegetation-management service by a party who does not live on site — [1.3 Why the transect earns its place](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-grazing)

**Covarying attribute bundle** — the attributes that move together along the transect, so naming a zone tells you many things at once — [1.1 Why scale, and why a transect rather than bins](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-transect-why)

## D

**Decommissioning / Repowering / Reversibility** — end-of-life questions: removing and restoring, replacing modules, and how completely the prior land use can return — [Decommissioning / Repowering / Reversibility](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-decommissioning)

**Design levers** — the degrees of freedom — structural, land-and-ecology, institutional — through which pressures get settled — [3.3 Design levers](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-levers)

**Design pressures** — the competing forces every site must settle; unlike axes they have direction, conflict, and advocates — [3. Design Pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd)

**Dual Use** — production-based criterion: active agricultural production in the footprint across the project life (AFT's definition); S1–S2 — [Dual Use](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-dual-use)

## E

**Ecovoltaics** — solar development incorporating ecological understanding into array design and management, co-prioritizing ecosystem function with generation (typically S3) — [Ecovoltaics](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-ecovoltaics)

## F

**Feasible wedge** — the feasible region across scale and sharing: all four sharing positions stay open through A3, narrowing toward A5 — [2.2 The feasible region is a wedge, not a rectangle](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-wedge)

**Footprint** — land physically occupied by racking, panels, and access infrastructure; paired with influence zone — [Footprint vs. Influence Zone](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-footprint-influence)

## G

**Generation yield** — design pressure: maximize energy per unit land — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

**Ground Coverage Ratio (GCR)** — ratio of module area to ground area; the array's density; the number behind the row-geometry ↔ ground-layer coupling — [Ground Coverage Ratio (GCR)](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-gcr)

**Ground Layer** — whatever occupies the surface beneath and between panels; primary carrier of restorative function — [Ground Layer](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-ground-layer)

## I

**Influence Zone** — the larger, typically asymmetric area whose hydrology, microclimate, soil, or wildlife movement is measurably affected — [Footprint vs. Influence Zone](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-footprint-influence)

**Integration** — functional interdependence — panel height set by livestock clearance, spacing by forage light, tracking by photosynthetic timing — [Co-location vs. Integration](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-colocation-integration)

## L

**Land Equivalent Ratio (LER)** — standard dual-use productivity metric; handles S3 ground layers poorly — [Land Equivalent Ratio (LER)](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-ler)

## M

**Management-led** — restoration mode: placement is a given; ground cover, grazing regime, and operational schedule carry everything — [1.4 Siting latitude and the restoration mode shift](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)

**Marginal / Previously Disturbed Land** — the low-value ground that sparing (S4) presupposes: low-yielding cropland, reclaimed mine land, landfills, brownfields ("brightfields") — [Marginal / Previously Disturbed Land](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-marginal-land)

**Microclimate Modification** — the array's reshaping of the below-panel environment (shade, temperature, evaporative demand, soil moisture); a restorative function (§6.4) — [Microclimate Modification](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-microclimate)

**Module Technology** — the panel as a lever: monofacial/bifacial, vertical bifacial, semitransparent, spectrally selective — [Module Technology](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-module-technology)

## O

**Offtake conformity** — design pressure: satisfy the criteria of whoever buys the power, attributes, or tax position — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

**Operational simplicity** — design pressure: minimize management burden across a 25–40 year asset life — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

## P

**Pore Space** — the three-dimensional volume between modules and between modules and ground; frames clearance as habitat and working space — [Pore Space](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-pore-space)

## R

**Restoration mode** — whether restorative work is delivered by choice of ground, array geometry, or operation — Siting-led, Structure-led, or Management-led — [1.4 Siting latitude and the restoration mode shift](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)

**Restorative** — the frame of the whole lexicon: ground-layer function as a design objective co-equal with generation — [Restorative](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-restorative)

**Restorative ambition** — design pressure: make ecological, hydrological, and economic resilience co-equal with generation — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

**Restorative function** — a restorative capacity of the land (hydrologic, soil & carbon, biodiversity & habitat, microclimate) reachable across many structural positions; a column of the archetype × function matrix — [6. Restorative Functions](6-restorative-functions.qmd)

## S

**S1 — Full sharing** — production continues within the array footprint, in the same ground — [2.1 The positions](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)

**S2 — Functional sharing** — ground layer productive but subordinate to the array; grazing, forage — [2.1 The positions](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)

**S3 — Substituted function** — ground layer delivers ecological rather than agricultural function — [2.1 The positions](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)

**S4 — Sparing** — array occupies ground removed from production because it was low-yielding or already idle — [2.1 The positions](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)

**Scale Transect** — a single gradient from farmstead to regional that most other terms are read against; defined by covarying bundles, not capacity — [1. The Scale Transect](1-the-scale-transect.qmd)

**Screening** — management of the array's outward visual presence (setbacks, buffers, berms, fencing, glint/glare); acts on the visual portion of the influence zone; dual-function — [Screening](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-screening)

**Sharing–Sparing Axis** — the scale-orthogonal dimension: whether the array shares land with production or spares low-value ground from it — [2. The Sharing–Sparing Axis](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd)

**Siting latitude** — the designer's freedom over where the array goes; governed by the operator at A1, by the land market and grid topology at A5 — [1.4 Siting latitude and the restoration mode shift](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)

**Siting-led** — restoration mode: the restorative work is done by the choice of ground; requires A2–A3 latitude — [1.4 Siting latitude and the restoration mode shift](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)

**Social license** — design pressure: secure and sustain community acceptance — [3.1 The pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures)

**Stocking density** — instantaneous animals per unit area at a moment; diverges from carrying capacity — [1.3 Why the transect earns its place](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-grazing)

**Structure-led** — restoration mode: array geometry is the instrument — clearance, row spacing, module transmissivity — [1.4 Siting latitude and the restoration mode shift](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)

## T

**Tracking Schedule & Curtailment** — operational-regime levers: how the array is steered through the day, and deliberate output reduction — [Tracking Schedule & Curtailment](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-tracking-curtailment)

**Type** — following New Urbanism's Archetype → Prototype → Type → Stereotype progression, the archetypes are Types: real, transformable instances — [5. Archetypes](5-archetypes.qmd)
